turns.assessment: The simultaneous OSC loss on oms.S11-S12.span3 and the reciprocal oms.S12-S11.span2, together with input LOS at the immediately downstream amplifiers in both directions, localizes a bidirectional cable break on that physical 84.2 km segment. The many concurrent OCH LOS and service/protection events are consistent with a hard fibre cut, not an individual client, transponder, ROADM-channel, or amplifier failure. Stable pump currents also argue against pump failure.

proposals.rationale: E52 (oms.S11-S12.span3) lost OSC at onset, while its reciprocal fibre oms.S12-S11.span2 also lost OSC simultaneously; the next amplifiers in both directions reported input LOS. This is the characteristic signature of both fibres in the cable being cut.
An extreme added loss could also suppress both payload and OSC, but simultaneous total loss on the corresponding fibres in both directions is much more typical of a cable cut.
